constraints: index's declared type (Boolean vs Integer) selects the operation: Boolean creates/deletes the field's default-type index; Integer creates an index of the specified type.
Passing False for index deletes all standard (non-composite, non-keyword) indexes associated with the field.
If the index already exists (True case) or does not exist (False case), the call has no effect.

overloadMerges.note: Adds sentinelValues distinguishing the Boolean create/delete meaning from the Integer index-type-constant meaning of index, and documents the trailing '*' as an async-indexing literal flag rather than a generic Operator value.

sentinelValues.meaning: create an index of the default type for the field
delete all standard indexes associated with the field
create a Keywords index (Text/Alpha fields only)
create an index using the 4D-chosen default index type

params.description: If passed, the indexing operation is performed asynchronously.
